subject: CMIP6 model CNRM-ESM2-1 (CNRM-CERFACS)

gates.evidence: Net top-of-atmosphere drift +1.485 W/m2 against a 0.1 W/m2 tolerance — fails
gates.producer: Data: data/climate/cmip6_drift.json (Irving et al. 2021, three independent ledgers); Script: python3 scripts/issue_certificate.py --all; Module: src/pacland/climate/cmip6_drift.py
gates.remedy: apply a conservation correction to the projections, or exclude the model and use the conserving five — the drift is a constant in the control run, so it is subtractable, and CMIP6 has models that do not need the correction

gates.evidence: Exceeds the Earth's energy imbalance of 0.77 W/m2 — the signal the model exists to project
gates.producer: Data: data/climate/cmip6_drift.json (Irving et al. 2021, three independent ledgers); Script: python3 scripts/issue_certificate.py --all; Module: src/pacland/climate/cmip6_drift.py
gates.remedy: for projections where the signal is smaller than the leak, weight the ensemble toward conserving models — a 1.9x-EEI drift is larger than the effect being attributed to it

gates.evidence: Mass drift +0.44 mm/yr sea-level equivalent (fail); salt drift -1.94e-06 (pass)
gates.producer: Data: data/climate/cmip6_drift.json (Irving et al. 2021, three independent ledgers); Script: python3 scripts/issue_certificate.py --all; Module: src/pacland/climate/cmip6_drift.py
gates.remedy: fix the failing check before relying on this claim; the falsifier names what to repair

gates.evidence: 12 of 19 CMIP6 models fail the energy ledger and 5 conserve all three — the model is graded against a population, not a single threshold
gates.producer: Data: data/climate/cmip6_drift.json (Irving et al. 2021, three independent ledgers); Script: python3 scripts/issue_certificate.py --all; Module: src/pacland/climate/cmip6_drift.py
gates.falsifier: not stated — this finding records a measurement without naming the failure it rules out
gates.remedy: none — the check passes; keep the evidence and re-run on change

limitations: Conservation drift is necessary and not sufficient: a conserving model can still be wrong about feedbacks.
Drift is measured in the control run; behaviour under forcing is a separate test.
Grading uses the three ledgers published by Irving et al. (2021); other consistency tests exist and are not applied here.
